name: Carboprost Tromethamine
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Carboprost tromethamine injection, USP Sterile Solution is available in the following packages:
                  1 mL single-dose vial NDC 0143-9442-01
                  10 × 1 mL single-dose vials NDC 0143-9442-10
                  Each mL of carboprost tromethamine injection contains carboprost tromethamine equivalent to 250 mcg of carboprost.
adverseReactions_original:
Hypersensitivity (including anaphylaxis and angioedema) to Carboprost tromethamine injection Sterile Solution [see ADVERSE REACTIONS, Post-marketing Experience]
                     
                     Acute pelvic inﬂammatory disease
                     Patients with active cardiac, pulmonary, renal or hepatic disease
